label: Existence
resolution: V’s nonempty function, VI’s unique description and the modern ActualAt predicate have different types and truth conditions. The alternative individual predicate does not refute Russell inside his strict semantic restriction; quantifier truth is never silently read as a ground. EXISTENCE_4 (extranuclear existence of an object, Parsons-style reconstruction of Meinong) and EXISTENCE_5 (the watered-down nuclear property 'existent') are separate Lean declarations of a nuclear-property frame; the nuclear-characterization control shows that characterization confers EXISTENCE_5 and not EXISTENCE_4, so no argument passes from the one to the other without an explicit bridge. Neither is identified with EXISTENCE_1, EXISTENCE_2 or EXISTENCE_3.
